GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifetd back 6l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well without threatening # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Shifted out abruptly over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away evenly. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field 3 Wide With Cover (4L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed out Four Wide @ 400m. Pushed along Five Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Off heels @ 200m & ran on well in well in last 150m. # Touch unlucky.

Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 5 Lengths 3 Wide , made no ground to turn, carrieded 3 Wide rounding turn, Hooked Out widest Straightening Up and Made Good Ground down the outside in straight. [Stewards: raced keenly early/middle stages.] # just missed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Carried wider rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, ran on well doing best work late # hit line strong
Jumped Well led x 1 length home turn led x 0.3l Straightening Up Middle Of Track died on run # led/ faded

Jumped fairly. Pushed fwd & raced 3rd 3 Wide No Cover (2.5L from lead) early . Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & laid in @ 150m. Challenged leaders @ 100m & did best late. winkers first time. # Wide/too strong
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to a half length Lead on fence, Held Together up front & led 1.5 Lengths jointly turning, Headed 200m and lost a length or So to the line. (Blinkers, Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) & Tongue Tie -All- OFF FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Inclined to lay out final 200m and proved difficult to ride out.] # led/battled fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out abruptly approaching the 200m. Was then inclined to lay out over the final 200m and proved difficult to ride out fully.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Settled Down Off Mid-Field Two Wide 7 Lengths followed winner in run only Held Ground # needs easier
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Near the 1100m when racing keenly was steadied when close to heels. Held up for clear running over the final 100m between runners both of which shifted ground.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1-2l jumped awkwardly Settled Down tail keen 7l Off Mid-Field Turn Middle Of Track 5-6l ran on well # start against/sound
Bit Slow Out Not Bustled Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide No Cover 4 Lengths pushed very Wide Turn Given No Hope weakened but not badly Blinkers 1st Time t/tie on Need To See Again # wide/forgive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover for the majority of the event. Laid outwards over the final 200m.
